open.title: Open the spring garden
open.overview: Turn the beds the last people left, feed them, and get the seedlings out after the last frost.

comments.author: person-seat-b
comments.body: The soil is better than we feared: dark to a spade's depth along the wall, clay under the gate. Four barrows of compost went on the long bed.

comments.author: person-seat-a
comments.body: Everything is out. Twenty two tomatoes, six squash, the peppers in the warmest corner. Seeds and compost came to a hundred and nine dollars, the plot keeps the lines.

comments.author: person-seat-a
comments.body: Dahlias staked with the chestnut stakes from the barn. That is the spring garden open, I think.
